strings.name: Friedrich Merz
strings.summary: A judge and business lawyer, Merz served in the European Parliament and Bundestag and led the Union parliamentary group. After leaving parliament for legal work, he returned in 2021 and led the CDU. Following the 2025 election he became chancellor on a second ballot, leading a coalition with the SPD. Economic, migration and welfare policies remained contested in 2026.
